e.title: 保险毕业生招聘模型崩溃
e.summary: 保险业毕业生招聘模型正在崩溃（行业分析）
e.body: 「The graduate hiring model that built insurance is breaking down」（insurancebusinessmag AU）：构建保险业的毕业生招聘模型正在崩溃——人才获取的结构性变化。对 RIAA：保险招聘的结构性变化信号——与 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亚洲市场）、[[dwsimpson-market-trends-2026]]（招聘趋势）配套：毕业生招聘的转型；理解「招聘模型崩溃」的含义（技能要求/渠道变化）；求职策略的调整信号（尽早建立 AI 技能）。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：insurancebusinessmag 文章确认（毕业生招聘模型崩溃分析），未通读
e.title_hk: 保險畢業生招聘模型崩潰
e.summary_en: The graduate hiring model that built insurance is breaking down (industry analysis)
e.summary_hk: 保險業畢業生招聘模型正在崩潰（行業分析）
e.body_en: 'The graduate hiring model that built insurance is breaking down' (insurancebusinessmag AU): the structural change of talent acquisition — the hiring model that built the insurance industry is transforming. For RIAA: a structural-change signal of insurance hiring — with [[asia-actuarial-job-market]] (Asia market) and [[dwsimpson-market-trends-2026]] (recruiting trends) it frames the graduate-hiring transformation; understand the meaning of 'hiring-model breakdown' (skill requirements/channel changes); an adjustment signal for job strategies (build AI skills early).
e.body_hk: 「The graduate hiring model that built insurance is breaking down」（insurancebusinessmag AU）：構建保險業的畢業生招聘模型正在崩潰——人才獲取的結構性變化。對 RIAA：保險招聘的結構性變化信號——與 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亞洲市場）、[[dwsimpson-market-trends-2026]]（招聘趨勢）配套：畢業生招聘的轉型；理解「招聘模型崩潰」的含義（技能要求/渠道變化）；求職策略的調整信號（儘早建立 AI 技能）。
